documents.title: Viewer Deep Link Context Round Trip
documents.description:
Project, environment, run or logical group, projection, and current page must round-trip through
the URL while existing node-only links remain backward compatible.

tests.title: Building a hash for a node view without a runView omits the projection suffix (backward compatible)
Building a hash with runView 'combined' also omits the suffix, since combined is the default
Building a hash with runView 'physical' appends a '?view=physical' suffix
Resolving a hash with no '?view=' suffix defaults to no explicit runView (callers default to combined)
Resolving a hash with '?view=physical' recovers 'physical' as the runView alongside the resolved node
A build-then-resolve round trip for a physical projection recovers the exact same node and runView
An unrecognized query value other than 'physical' resolves as no explicit runView (defaults to combined)
The summary (home) view never carries a projection suffix, even when runView is 'physical'
A contextual node link preserves project 'Demo.Tests', environment 'ci', run 'partial-2', and view 'physical'
A summary link preserves run 'partial-2' instead of returning an empty hash
A run-qualified link selects 'partial-2' when '2' candidates contain the same node
A grouped link preserves group 'group:ci:demo:integration-1+unit-1' and '2' source runs

documents.title: Namespace Display Projection
documents.description: A shorter namespace presentation keeps canonical report identities and saved navigation intact.

tests.title: The <kind> namespace Acme/Commerce/Quotes/Services/Transactor/UnitTests shows Authentication and ResourceProviders, retaining both full-path group identities
Framework <framework> with paths <first> and <second> retains visible roots <roots>
A single document at 'Acme/Commerce/Tests/Check.cs' displays 'Document 0' with canonical ID 'doc-0'
Branching at 'Acme/Tests' retains 'Billing/Lifecycle/Renewals' beside 'Authentication' without losing direct 'Document 2'
Hidden ancestor 'group:Acme/Commerce/Quotes' still round-trips through '#/group/Acme/Commerce/Quotes' and opens 'Authentication,ResourceProviders'

documents.title: Viewer Run Grouping
documents.description: Logical project grouping should represent one solution/test run at a time.

tests.title: Repeated project ids split one solution run into '2' logical groups
Partial rerun leaves only the original multi-project group grouped as '1' group
Duplicate-triggered split resets the time window and still forms '2' groups
Back-to-back duplicate project ids keep only the latest complete solution run in '2' groups
'2' historical groups for one project and environment produce '1' current project entry

documents.title: Viewer Run History Badges
documents.description:
Deriving 'Full' / 'Partial n' badges for the chronological run dropdown has no stored sequence
field — the badge is purely a function of chronological order since the most recent full run.

tests.title: A full run followed by '3' partial reruns is badged 'Full, Partial 1, Partial 2, Partial 3' in order
A second full baseline resets the partial sequence back to '1' for the next partial
Entries missing a runType are treated as 'full', preserving pre-partial-support history
Server history order yields partial sequence '2' even when producer timestamps are out of order
formatRunBadge renders 'Full' and 'Partial 2' for the respective badge kinds
Merging history with a live in-progress entry prefers the live entry's fresher status
Merging de-duplicates by runId, preferring the live/loaded entry over stale history metadata
Merging duplicate Combined and physical live entries keeps only '1' run menu entry

documents.title: Viewer Run Projection Store
documents.description:
Combined runs and physical (partial) run projections are cached separately so grouping/logical
run inputs — which only ever read the combined 'runs' collection — can never be corrupted by an
active partial's physical data.

tests.title: Selecting a run without specifying a projection defaults 'selectedRunView' to 'combined'
Selecting a run with an explicit 'physical' projection is preserved on the store
Selecting a run group always resets the projection back to 'combined'
Follow latest disabled keeps selected run 'run-a' when newer run 'run-b' arrives
Follow latest enabled switches selected run from 'run-a' to newer run 'run-b'
Follow latest enabled selects '1' containing group after '2' related projects arrive
upsertPhysicalRun stores data only in the physical cache, leaving 'runs' — and therefore grouping inputs — untouched
getCurrentRun returns the combined projection with '2' documents when runs holds it and the view is combined
Toggling to the physical projection returns just '1' document for the same selected run
An active partial with no combined snapshot yet still resolves via the physical cache when the view defaults back to combined
A completed partial does not masquerade as Combined while its combined projection is loading
Real-time testcase upserts route to the physical cache when the runId is only tracked there, never touching 'runs'
Real-time testcase upserts continue to route to 'runs' for full runs, unaffected by the physical cache split
A failed testcase upsert keeps an active full run 'running' while recording '1' failure
Late partial testcase updates change only the physical projection while Combined stays at '2' documents
Partial coverage '50' updates This partial while Combined baseline coverage remains '100'
removeRun also evicts any physical cache entry for the same runId, preventing an orphaned toggle target
